raw.query: SELECT candidate, h, AVG(wape) AS avg_wape, COUNT(*) AS n FROM forecast_metrics WHERE h IN (1,3,6,9,12) GROUP BY candidate, h ORDER BY candidate, h;
raw.evidence: Across the 12-step horizon aggregate WAPE rises ~23pp absolute / ~32% relative; burst-onset tail candidates (p70/p80/p90) degrade 43-63%, far exceeding 'marginal'.
